classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding lengths in overlapping figures and combine labelled segments before calculating the scale factor.

content.prompt:
Determine the scale factor for each case. You may need to redraw as two separate diagrams.
The purple shape is the original, the blue shape is the image.

spec.description: Unfilled nested rectangles share their bottom-left corner. Purple identifies the original and blue identifies the image. The 8 cm label belongs only to the additional vertical segment above the original.
spec.mathematics: The original height is 2 cm; the image height is 2 + 8 = 10 cm. Exact source drawing dimensions are unspecified.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements appear; no answer is drawn.

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Image height}&=2+8=10\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{\text{image length}}{\text{original length}}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{10}{2}=5\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Unfilled nested triangles share an apex and sloping side directions, with parallel horizontal bases. Preserve a cross at the apex, corresponding left-base dots and corresponding right-base filled squares.
spec.mathematics: The original right side is 6 cm and its extension is 2 cm, giving an image side of 8 cm. The original is three quarters of the image.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and correspondence markers appear.

spec.description: Unfilled nested rectangles share their bottom-left corner. The original bottom side is labelled 5 cm; the additional bottom segment beyond it is labelled 11 cm.
spec.mathematics: Original width 5 cm; image width 5 + 11 = 16 cm. Exact source drawing dimensions are unspecified.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements appear; no answer is drawn.

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Image width}&=5+11=16\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{\text{image length}}{\text{original length}}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{16}{5}=3.2\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Nested unfilled right triangles share the top-left vertex and hypotenuse direction. Horizontal bases are parallel. Preserve the shared vertex dot, both outlined right-angle squares and both rightmost-vertex crosses.
spec.mathematics: Original vertical side 6 cm; additional vertical segment 3 cm; image vertical side 9 cm. The original is two thirds of the image.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and correspondence markers appear.

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Image height}&=6+3=9\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{\text{image length}}{\text{original length}}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{9}{6}=1.5\end{aligned}$
